FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Fashion Haven is a contemporary clothing and apparel retail business located in New York City, focused on offering a diverse range of fashionable and affordable clothing options for men, women, and children. Our operations are primarily centered around a physical storefront complemented by an online sales platform, ensuring a balanced approach that adheres to our policy guideline of maintaining less than 75% of our total revenue from online sales. 

We pride ourselves on a well-managed inventory system, enabling us to minimize exposure to theft and loss claims while enhancing our operational efficiency. Our offerings include seasonal collections and accessories, ensuring we meet the needs of our customers throughout the year.

In addition to retail, we engage in minimal alteration services, not exceeding 10% of our business activities. These alterations are carried out in compliance with local regulations, reflecting our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. Our store is equipped with a robust security system, enhancing our ability to protect our assets effectively.

Fashion Haven is dedicated to maintaining compliance with all relevant labor laws, safety standards, and consumer protection regulations, fostering a positive shopping experience while safeguarding our employees' well-being. Our vendor relationships are carefully curated to ensure quality and reliability in our product offerings, contributing to our favorable position within the retail industry.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, Fashion Haven experienced a loss due to a minor flood in the storage area, resulting in damaged merchandise valued at $3,000. The situation was promptly addressed, and the affected items were either salvaged or disposed of accordingly. The loss was reported to the insurance company and is currently under review. Status: Open.
